question: How many Table 2 entries use fed-batch cultivation, and how does that compare with shake flask?

trace.query: SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND col_no=4 ORDER BY row_no
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND row_no>=33 ORDER BY row_no, col_no

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE col4='fed-batch') AS fed_batch, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE col4='shake flask') AS shake_flask, COUNT(*) AS entries FROM (SELECT r.row_no, MAX(CASE WHEN c.col_no=4 THEN c.text END) AS col4 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT row_no FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND col_no=7 AND row_no>1) r JOIN cells c ON c.table_id='p9.T2' AND c.row_no=r.row_no) t

SELECT c4.text AS mode, COUNT(*) AS n FROM cells c7 JOIN cells c4 ON c4.table_id=c7.table_id AND c4.row_no=c7.row_no AND c4.col_no=4 WHERE c7.table_id='p9.T2' AND c7.col_no=7 AND c7.row_no>1 GROUP BY c4.text ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT id, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND col_no=4 AND text IN ('fed-batch','shake flask') ORDER BY row_no LIMIT 6
